ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, lines AB and CD intersect at point O, with OA bisecting $\angle EOC$. If $\angle EOC = \frac{2}{3}\angle EOD$, find the degree measure of $\angle BOD$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: Since $\angle EOC = \frac{2}{3}\angle EOD$ and $\angle EOC + \angle EOD = 180^\circ$,\\
thus $\frac{2}{3}\angle EOD + \angle EOD = 180^\circ$,\\
which implies $\frac{5}{3}\angle EOD = 180^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle EOD = 108^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle EOC = \frac{2}{3} \times 108^\circ = 72^\circ$,\\
since OA bisects $\angle EOC$,\\
it follows that $\angle AOC = \frac{1}{2}\angle EOC = \frac{1}{2} \times 72^\circ = 36^\circ$,\\
since lines AB and CD intersect at point O,\\
thus $\angle BOD = \angle AOC = \boxed{36^\circ}$;
